title: Structure--Residual Inductive Biases for Language Model Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.23197v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Next-token prediction is relied upon to learn both predictive behavior and internal representations. We ask whether representation structure itself should be an explicit inductive bias. Motivated by the two-part coding view of Kolmogorov complexity, we study a structure--residual principle in which a representation separates structure from realization detail. We instantiate this principle in two complementary ways. Boundary Bottleneck Concept (BBC) routes information from token segments through boundary carriers while preserving local autoregressive computation. Continuous Concept (CC) regularizes representation geometry and induces a spectral decomposition into low-frequency structure and high-frequency residual. We derive coding bounds for both views and show that multiplicity-corrected boundary attention becomes exact as the within-segment path energy vanishes. Empirically, BBC and CC exhibit strikingly different depth preferences:

translated_title: 面向语言模型预训练的结构—残差归纳偏置
translated_abstract: 下一个词预测被普遍依赖用于同时学习预测行为和内部表示。我们提出这样一个问题：表示结构本身是否应当作为一种显式的归纳偏置。受Kolmogorov复杂度两部分编码观点的启发，我们研究了一种结构—残差原则，在该原则中，表示将结构与实现细节分离开来。我们以两种互补的方式实例化这一原则：边界瓶颈概念（BBC）将信息从词元片段通过边界载体进行路由，同时保留局部自回归计算；连续概念（CC）则对表示几何进行正则化，并诱导出将表示谱分解为低频结构与高频残差的形式。我们为两种视角推导了编码界，并证明当片段内路径能量趋于消失时，经多重性校正的边界注意力变为精确的。在实证方面，BBC与CC表现出截然不同的深度偏好。
tldr: 提出一种结构—残差归纳偏置原则，通过边界瓶颈概念（BBC）和连续概念（CC）两种机制将语言模型表示中的结构与实现细节分离，并推导出相应的编码界，发现二者在深度偏好上存在显著差异。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structure-residual inductive bias principle for language model pretraining, instantiated via Boundary Bottleneck Concept (BBC) and Continuous Concept (CC) to separate structure from realization detail in representations, deriving coding bounds and showing strikingly different depth preferences between the two.
